# TASK-152 — Exported skill follows the guide

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Skill best practices (2026-10-01)

## Intent

The exported project skill is a product feature, so it must be valid for any project name (a name containing "Claude" or markup produced an invalid skill), keep the description free of volatile facts such as the revision, give every long reference a contents list, avoid references that point to other references, skip files for sections nobody has answered yet, and tell the agent which items are binding (accepted requirements and decisions, security, conventions) and which call for judgement.

## What it delivers

Moved to `api/skill-export.ts`; the exporter had produced an invalid skill for names with "Claude" or markup, an unquoted description containing ": ", and three long references without a contents list. Tests: `tests/skill-audit.test.ts`, `tests/agent-exports.test.ts`.
